name: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition

steam.store_details: Delisted from Steam in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale. OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) distributes a free, Epic-authorized copy of the full game.
steam.patches: Creative's official 'EAX Library Patch' (uteaxsys.zip, then uteaxdm.zip and uteaxctf.zip) adds full EAX 2.0 reverb and muffling of sounds through walls to the original Deathmatch and Capture the Flag maps — historically mirrored at patches-scrolls.com; verify the mirror and files before installing. OldUnreal's patches add a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Unreal Tournament ships with its hardware sound option off, and it only plays EAX reverb with it on.
